assessment: The manuscript by Nguyen et al. describes the assignment of neuronal cell types to human lumbar dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons based on the sequencing of individual nuclei. Bioinformatic comparison of these data to single nucleus sequencing results previously reported for mouse lumbar DRG is also described. The findings begin to close a gap in our understanding of how neuronal cell types and the expression of key genes differs between human and mouse. This kind of information is critical for targeted therapeutic efforts.
